function.name: ILAppendID
function.signature: LPITEMIDLIST WINAPI ILAppendID(LPITEMIDLIST pidl, LPCSHITEMID item, BOOL bEnd)
function.header_comment:
/*************************************************************************
 * ILAppendID                [SHELL32.154]
 *
 * Adds the single ItemID item to the ItemIDList indicated by pidl.
 * If bEnd is FALSE, inserts the item in the front of the list,
 * otherwise it adds the item to the end. (???)
 *
 * PARAMS
 *  pidl       [I]   ItemIDList to extend
 *  item       [I]   ItemID to prepend/append
 *  bEnd       [I]   Indicates if the item should be appended
 *
 * NOTES
 *  Destroys the passed in idlist! (???)
 */

When the function returns, the SHITEMID structure specified by pmkid is appended or prepended. ### -param pmkid [in] Type: LPSHITEMID A pointer to a SHITEMID structure to be appended or prepended to pidl. ### -param fAppend Type: BOOL Value that is set to TRUE to append pmkid to pidl.
